name: payup
description: Chase overdue invoices conversationally from Slack. Reads overdue-and-unpaid invoices from QuickBooks (or Wave), drafts tiered reminders (gentle, firm, final), sends via Gmail behind a human-in-the-loop gate, and stops automatically when the invoice is marked paid. Replaces the AR/reminder slice of Bill.com. Never moves money. Setup in Claude Code; operate from Slack.

qbo_access_token.title: QuickBooks access token
qbo_access_token.description: OAuth access token for QuickBooks Online (scope com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting). Read-only use: PayUp only queries invoices, it never mutates QuickBooks.

qbo_realm_id.title: QuickBooks realm (company) id
qbo_realm_id.description: The sandbox or production company id whose invoices to chase.

gmail_token_path.title: Gmail token path
gmail_token_path.description: Path to the OAuth token produced by engine/scripts/gmail_oauth_setup.py (default config/token.json). Gitignored.
